purpose.en: Prepare the integrated candidate through the release owner.
purpose.zh: 由发布负责人统一准备集成候选。

entry.en: Integrated candidate and publication authorization when needed
entry.zh: 集成候选就绪；发布操作具备授权

exit.en: Release evidence names the actual candidate and remaining limits.
exit.zh: 发布证据对应实际候选，并列出剩余限制。

failure.en: Repair the same target release; keep published source and target fixed.
failure.zh: 修复同一目标发布，保持已发布源与目标边界固定。

boundary.en: Packaging, signing, publication and production effects retain their actual authorization.
boundary.zh: 打包、签名、发布与生产影响遵循各自实际授权边界。
